message.ore_detector_reborn.welcome.rewo: This is a full rework. The eleven old detectors are gone, replaced by one Ore Detector you attune to whatever you want to find.
message.ore_detector_reborn.welcome.cham: Everything starts in a Trial Chamber. Breeze rods, shards, crystals and heavy cores are what build the detector, the goggles and the Resonance Chamber.
message.ore_detector_reborn.welcome.adva: Press L to open your advancements. The whole progression is laid out there, step by step.
message.ore_detector_reborn.welcome.guid: The in-game guidebook arrives once Patchouli updates to this version.
message.ore_detector_reborn.welcome.lega: Still want the old detectors? Version 1.3.0 installs alongside this one and the two do not conflict.
text.autoconfig.ore_detector_reborn.opti: How long Nausea lasts when the goggles are pushed past their strain ceiling. Set to 0 to remove the effect and keep only the refusal.
Strain added each time the goggles show a scan, against a fixed ceiling of 100.
Goggle strain: ticks per point recovered
Ticks for one point of strain to bleed off. Higher recovers more slowly.
Strain only rises while the amount added per scan beats what decays during the scan cooldown.
Base reach of the beam. It goes three times this far down on a single loaded liquid, twice on two, and once on three or more.
Sideways and upward reach is three quarters of the downward reach, and the column widens from 3x3 to 7x7 as the beam shortens.
How long the detector rests between scans. 20 ticks is one second.
Volume of the detector's beep. Set to 0 to silence it without affecting anything else.
tooltip.ore_detector_reborn.goggles_shad: A shaderpack is running, so the highlight cannot draw through terrain.
